title: Looking for artists to join Illustrator pool

author: willai3213
title: Looking for exhibition graphic/character designer
content: Looking for a graphic designer to collaborate on exhibition visual design for a December 2026 show at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banner, other exhibition derivatives, and print prepress. Timeline Oct-Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style with exhibition/graphic design experience. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
